Drawers

A modal panel at the end of the screen - or at its start with drawer-start - for filters, a record's details, a long form beside the list it belongs to. Bootstrap 5 calls it offcanvas; it is a <dialog> here.

Examples

A drawer opens and closes like a dialog: command="show-modal" and command="close". It slides in from its side - mirrored right to left - unless the person asks for less motion.

Filters

Status

Sections

A drawer at the start edge: the left in English, the right in Arabic.

 
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-panel" command="show-modal"><i class="bi bi-funnel" aria-hidden="true"></i>Filters</button>
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-start" command="show-modal"><i class="bi bi-layout-sidebar" aria-hidden="true"></i>From the start</button>
<dialog id="drawer-filters-panel" class="drawer" closedby="any" aria-labelledby="drawer-filters-panel-title">
	<div class="drawer-header">
		<h2 class="drawer-title" id="drawer-filters-panel-title">Filters</h2>
		<button class="btn-close" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-panel" command="close" aria-label="Close"></button>
	</div>
	<div class="drawer-body vstack gap-16">
		<fieldset class="vstack gap-8">
			<legend class="form-label">Status</legend>
			<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" checked>Published</label>
			<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox">Draft</label>
		</fieldset>
		<div class="form-floating">
			<select class="form-select" id="drawer-filters-section"><option>Any section</option><option>Marine</option><option>Land</option></select>
			<label for="drawer-filters-section">Section</label>
		</div>
		<div class="hstack gap-8 justify-content-end">
			<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-panel" command="close">Reset</button>
			<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-panel" command="close">Show 9</button>
		</div>
	</div>
</dialog>
<dialog id="drawer-filters-start" class="drawer drawer-start" closedby="any" aria-labelledby="drawer-filters-start-title">
	<div class="drawer-header">
		<h2 class="drawer-title" id="drawer-filters-start-title">Sections</h2>
		<button class="btn-close" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-start" command="close" aria-label="Close"></button>
	</div>
	<div class="drawer-body"><p>A drawer at the start edge: the left in English, the right in Arabic.</p></div>
</dialog>

Wide

drawer-lg is 38rem (608 px) wide instead of 28rem, for a record's details with a table or a form of two columns; on a narrower window it takes the window less a margin, as every drawer does.

Booking 2026-0418

Ang Thong by speedboat, 4 guests, 12 November 2026. Paid in full by card.

 
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="drawer-lg-panel" command="show-modal"><i class="bi bi-receipt" aria-hidden="true"></i>Booking details</button>
<dialog id="drawer-lg-panel" class="drawer drawer-lg" closedby="any" aria-labelledby="drawer-lg-panel-title">
	<div class="drawer-header">
		<h2 class="drawer-title" id="drawer-lg-panel-title">Booking 2026-0418</h2>
		<button class="btn-close" type="button" commandfor="drawer-lg-panel" command="close" aria-label="Close"></button>
	</div>
	<div class="drawer-body"><p>Ang Thong by speedboat, 4 guests, 12 November 2026. Paid in full by card.</p></div>
</dialog>

Keyboard and accessibility

  • Everything said of dialogs holds: the focus moves in and back, Tab stays inside, Esc closes.
  • A drawer is a region: the width prefixes inside it measure the drawer, 28 rem wide at most.
  • The drawer's body scrolls by itself; its header stays.

Tokens

From css/components/drawer.css, which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's --redz-space-8, --redz-border, --redz-radius-12, --redz-bg-raised, --redz-shadow-3, --redz-space-12, --redz-space-16, --redz-fs-16, --redz-ease.
